intro: Work long, stay light. The RELAX 360 Chair combines breathable mesh, ergonomic support, and easy adjustability—keeping you cool, comfortable, and focused all day

features.title: Design that embraces every body
features.text: With outwardly curved, full-length arms and a deep, broad seat, RELAX 360 gives you complete relaxation, designed to fit and support almost every body stature.

features.title: Breathability that keeps you fresh
features.text: Your mesh back with its curved profile ensures airflow and sturdy support, reducing heat build-up and keeping you cool, comfortable, and energised during long hours

features.title: A fit that feels just right
features.text: Personalise your comfort with easy seat height adjustment, set the right level for your posture so your workdays feel lighter, healthier, and effortlessly productive.

features.title: Eco-smart design, built for you
features.text: Our GREENGUARD-certified build uses non-toxic, sustainable materials—protecting your health while contributing to a cleaner, greener planet.

name: Relax Revolving Chair
